body: Hi [@Bharathcoorg](https://gov.edgewa.re/edgeware/account/i1tffC8QVVUgGb8RjazGRz72SDxtP35kqa2RB7vnVhjRHPV) would it be possible to have a bridge on to Arbitrum?
Yes. It's already supported. All popular EVM blockchains are supported. You want me to add EDG to Arbitrum?

Hey [@Bharathcoorg](/edgeware/account/i1tffC8QVVUgGb8RjazGRz72SDxtP35kqa2RB7vnVhjRHPV) are any of these options 'trustless' or do they require a multisig escrow type account? Just wondering if there was any recommendation you'd make on the security of each.

This bridge is decentralized and trustless, just like the Anyswap/Multichain Bridge. We want smart contract audits and have already requested quotes from Certik, Verichain, and Hacken.
Bridges are always a favorite place for hackers. We have nodes running in AWS for this bridge; currently, it's a single account used for signing transactions. I want to add more nodes and keys using multi-signature in the next upgrade.
